rationale: The 2026-10-19 audit showed that self-verification passed while the benchmark was never executed and author metadata was wrong. Proposer, verifier, and approver must therefore be different sessions. This session installs the harness but cannot review or approve this proposal.
summary: Install a session-based separation-of-duties harness: (1) role policy and a guard that binds each commit to a session and branch; (2) append-only state with revision chains and a frozen baseline; (3) an append-only review queue plus a standard verification suite and a hand-off generator for the next manual Arena chat.
title: Adopt the ResearchOS governance harness (roles, append-only state, review queue)
